pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit low edge angularity with smooth, blurred pixel gradients between the brown and cream zones. Individual patches are predominantly rounded polygonal shapes with the largest spatial area observed on the neck and shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological graph with junction nodes primarily characterized by tri-radiate intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively stable across the flank and torso, maintaining high continuity with minimal pixel-width variance.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder creates a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette consisting of short, dense hair segments against the background.
